```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)


exerpts <- readRDS("tag_rel_exerpts_ls.rds")
sprintf()

exerpts$tot_rel_all <- paste(signif(exerpts$tot_rel_all/1000000,1),"million")

orig_nms <- names(exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v)
exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v <- paste(round(exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v/1000000,1),"million")
names(exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v) <- orig_nms
# exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v <- prettyNum(exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v,big.mark = ",")

exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_W_prop_v <- signif(exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_W_prop_v,2)


```

Approximately `r exerpts$tot_rel_all`  tags were released upstream of Lower Granite Dam in the Snake River Basin between 1996 and 2025, including `r exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v["SR_Ch1"]` yearling Chinook Salmon, `r exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v["SR_Sthd"]` Steelhead, and `r exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_rtcomb_v["SR_Sock"]` Sockeye Salmon.  More hatchery-origin fish were released overall, but the composition of tags varied considerably across populations and over time. The proportion of wild-origin fish was `r exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_W_prop_v["SR_Ch1"]` for Chinook Salmon, `r exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_W_prop_v["SR_Sthd"]` for Steelhead, and only `r exerpts$unfilt_rel_tgs_W_prop_v["SR_Sock"]` for Sockeye Salmon.
